moments.author: James Harden
moments.quote: Agreed to a new three‑year, $97 million contract to stay with the Cavaliers (player option + trade kicker).
moments.why: A major NBA veteran re‑signing—huge for Cavs fans and cap‑watchers.

moments.author: Buss Family / Sources via ESPN
moments.quote: Buss family agrees to sell its remaining 17.8 % Lakers stake to Bob Iger and Josh Kushner—ending decades of family control.
moments.why: End of an era: Lakers leaving Buss family hands is massive in sports and culture.

moments.author: Minnesota Timberwolves news via Axios
moments.quote: Timberwolves being sold for $4.5 billion, less than a week after Lakers sale to Iger & Kushner.
moments.why: Back‑to‑back record NBA franchise sales—wild acceleration in sports valuations.
